title: Field probe pocket catalog - latency & mini metrics
content:
Quick pocket catalog for ad-hoc field probes. Use as personal experiment ledger when doing fast sweeps. Very informal. Columns explained below; keep single-line rows when copying to CSV.

Columns:
- date
- exp_id (short)
- prompt_tag
- model_var
- seq_len
- batch
- p50_ms
- p95_ms
- tps (tokens/sec)
- cost_cents_per_1k_tok
- notes

Recent rows (copy-paste friendly CSV):
2024-05-01,FP-61,role-instr-v2,redwood-13b-q4,512,1,23,78,120,0.18,went well, cache warm
2024-05-02,FP-62,temp-sweep,redwood-13b-q4,1024,2,48,160,110,0.15,kv-cache off, big p95
2024-05-02,FP-63,reduce-dose,redwood-7b-q3,512,4,16,45,210,0.06,cheap and fast, quality ok for short prompts

Notes / heuristics:
- p50 stable across repeats; p95 noisy when seq_len > 800 or batch > 2
- When p95 spikes, check KV cache hit rate (see INF-2143) and thundering small requests
- Use batch 2 for 13B on dev racks, but revert to 1 for latency-sensitive routes

To-dos / experiments to schedule:
- FP-64: sweep quant-configs for 7B (q8_0, q4f) — expected cost delta ~25%
- FP-65: prefix caching with mixed requests (partial keys) — needs SRE help to instrument logs
- FP-66: short prompt stress test at seq 2048 with batch1

Open questions:
- How often does model_var \"redwood-13b-q4\" fallback to 13b-fp16 under load? (observed once)
- Best quick metric for user-visible lag? p95 or 99? My gut: p95 plus sample user-perf probe.

Useful commands / snippets:
- small curl for quick local test:
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-q4","prompt":"...","max_tokens":512}' | jq '.latency_ms'

- quick run to extract p95 from trace logs:
gzcat traces-2024-05-02.log.gz | grep \"exp_id=FP-62\" | jq '.latency_ms' | python -c \"import sys,statistics as s; print(s.quantiles([float(l) for l in sys.stdin], n=100)[94])\"

Other quick notes:
- Keep small CSV rows in clipboard for fast import into team sheet when needed.
- If FP series crosses threshold (cost> $0.50/1k tokens) ping Rhea for budget approval.

Scratch: used as my daily pocket sheet. archive rows monthly into /shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/experiments/personal-archives/penelope-2024Q2.csv
